mission: Refuse collector releases while any collector has a Railway GitHub deploy trigger (capacity75 session 10, tooling and tests only)

impacts.reason: Delivery tooling only (scripts/, outside every collector and API runtime import graph): deploy_staging_collectors.refuse_github_triggers reads every collector's deployment triggers and auto-deploy status (read-only GraphQL) and refuses a forward collector release on any trigger, enabled auto-deploy, unreadable status or missing collector; collector_variables.change calls it before staging. Restore paths skip it. No collector rollout requested; no Railway collector build (collectors have no GitHub trigger since session 9).

Regression tests: trigger present on a non-requested collector refuses before any slot/upload; auto-deploy enabled refuses; missing collector or unreadable status fails closed; no trigger proceeds and the receipt records the check for all ten; rollback never runs the check; settings-only change refuses before staging.
